SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CD_PLANT AS PLANT, ADD_DATE, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ FROM KEP_GE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'ILHW' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, CD_PLANT AS PLANT, STATUS AS STATUS, ADD_DATE AS ADD_DATE, END_DATE AS CLOSE_DATE, ADD_DATE||QUOTATION_NO AS QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ AS QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION_NO AS REVISION, BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, UNIT_PRICE AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, REQ_USER_ID AS ADD_USER_ID, REQ_USER_NAME AS REQ_USER_NAME, REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME AS REQ_USER_DEPT, REQ_USER_NAME||':'||REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME AS HD_REMARK, REQ_USER_TELNO AS REQ_USER_TEL, RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY FROM KEP_GE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND CD_PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND ADD_DATE = '$G_RS.ADD_DATE$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' ORDER BY ADD_DATE,QUOTATION_NO,QUOTATION_SEQ
UPDATE KEP_GE SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND CD_PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND ADD_DATE = '$G_RS.ADD_DATE$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$'
